title: WL-12: Build the five-field whitelist
content: Create a simple whitelist with Name, Organization, Email, Phone Number, and Picture of Face. Store each submission and show a confirmation state.

title: PM removes phone number after privacy review
content: WL-12 privacy review: remove Phone Number from the whitelist. We do not need it for launch, and collecting it creates consent and retention work Legal has not approved. Name, Organization, Email, and Picture of Face remain in scope.

title: Johnny confirms the privacy scope change
content: Understood. I will remove Phone Number from WL-12 before opening the PR and keep the other four fields.

title: Claude finds no ready photo-storage path
content: Johnny asked whether the existing Supabase setup could accept profile photos without new infrastructure. Claude found no provisioned private bucket, signed-upload policy, retention rule, or deletion path. It recommended keeping the form to Name, Organization, and Email and seeking senior engineering approval for a storage follow-up.

title: Senior SWE defers picture upload and S3 setup
content: Agreed. Defer Picture of Face from WL-12. Ship Name, Organization, and Email only. S3-compatible storage, signed uploads, retention, and deletion need a separate reviewed setup before we collect photos.
